pages.title: Emberstar Cord Bracelet
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r 1% chance from any chests/* loot table.$(br2)§lEquip: §r Place it in the Curios Star, Stardust, or Emberstar Cord slot, or equip it in the player's offhand. Holding it in the main hand does not count.$(br2)§lEffects: §r Mob detection range -75%; Void Shelter damage reduction starts at 27.5% and grows to 75% with world time; 'Night Outside the Campfire' is only a name, and while equipped damage is ×3.5 with attack cooldown reduced by 50%; Disassembled Stardust has a 5% chance to convert hits to void damage.
